comparison.objective: Hammer a nail held by another robot arm, versus tune and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual/bi-arm impact coordination, nail stabilization, and striking; impact is shared only superficially because the candidate observes carriage impacts rather than delivering them with a tool.
comparison.success_condition: Body gives no nail depth, straightness, strike-force, hand-clearance, damage, or release criteria.
comparison.reason: Tests coordinated percussive fastening, not adjustment of damping based on repeated guarded cycles.
